definition: What a style says about one slot: it fixes it, adds to what it inherits, leaves it open, or forbids it outright. A style is these bindings, with its constraints, laid on one universal set of slots.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, the slot binding: specified, "this style fixes the slot and stops the cascade"; extends, "MERGE into the inherited value rather than replacing it"; open, "open: unspecified, cascades"; forbidden, "prohibited outright, stops the cascade". docs/inheritance.md: "A style is not a bag of parts." It is a set of bindings and constraints on a universal set of slots.
